notes: Created by the baseline audit of gateway-api/v1 as the destination of its three semantic post-freeze hunks: the gateway serves only configured devices, the reasoning response carries a required `device_id` and the runtime refuses an invalid `action_tier`, and an explicit `escalate_to: gateway` returns a gateway-unavailable result instead of falling back. The text is v1's as it stood on main before the audit removed those edits from v1; the additive families (runtime node heartbeat, enrichment, evidence carriage, exports) stay in v1. The runtime shipped the response rule in v1.0.0 and will be recorded here once it claims this version.
